overview_description.description:
Alchemy is a French company specialized in the development of softwares and computer services since 1996. 

Its flagship product is "Phraseanet", a Digital Asset Management software for companies who need to manage and share their digital files (pictures, videos, audio & PDF documents) efficiently. 
Phraseanet is an Open Source DAM software distributed under GNU Public License 3 since March 2010. 
The software is web based,  built on standard technologies (Php, MySQL, Apache). This DAM system has 7 interfaces, such as a thesaurus, an administration interface and statistics.
